The larvae create shelters by loosely spinning together the leaves of their host plants and can be found feeding in groups. The pupa develops inside a thin cocoon. 100838.l: The Adelidae or fairy longhorn moths are a family of monotrysian moths in the lepidopteran infraorder Heteroneura.
